entries.description: who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]
entries.subject: who
entries.object: be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]

spans.text: [11] AR: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ EN: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
[12] AR: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ EN: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
[14] AR: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ EN: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

entries.description: it there will be no delay
entries.subject: it there

spans.text: [15] AR: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ EN: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

entries.task_id: kingdom and|gave|him wisdom and discernment in speech
entries.description: kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech
entries.subject: kingdom and
entries.object: him wisdom and discernment in speech

spans.text: [20] AR: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ EN: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

entries.task_id: and david|became|certain that we had tried him
entries.description: And David became certain that We had tried him
entries.subject: And David
entries.object: certain that We had tried him

spans.text: And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].

entries.subject: as it
entries.object: lead you astray from the way of Allah

spans.text: [26] AR: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ EN: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah."

entries.task_id: of allah|will|have a severe punishment for having forgotten the day of account
entries.description: of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account
entries.subject: of Allah
entries.object: have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account

spans.text: Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
[30] AR: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ EN: And to David We gave Solomon.

entries.subject: I
entries.object: preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]

spans.text: [32] AR: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ EN: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
